description: This file defines API routes for managing code snippets, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting snippets. It uses FastAPI with SQLAlchemy for database interactions and manages user-specific snippets with authentication dependencies.

methods.name: list[SnippetOut] list_snippets(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns all snippets for the authenticated user.

methods.name: SnippetOut create_snippet(payload: SnippetCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new code snippet for the current user.

methods.name: SnippetOut get_snippet( snippet_id: int = Path(..., description="Snippet ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific snippet owned by the current user by ID.

methods.name: SnippetOut update_snippet( payload: SnippetUpdate, snippet_id: int = Path(..., description="Snippet ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates title and/or code of an owned snippet.

methods.name: delete_snippet( snippet_id: int = Path(..., description="Snippet ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a snippet owned by the current user.
